notificationBanner.text: Stay in the loop. Turn on notifications for handoffs, order requests and hot leads.

home.title: Welcome to Nihasdesk
home.subtitle: Your inbox, AI agent and team in one place.

empty.title: No conversation selected
empty.text: Pick a conversation from the list to read it, reply or take over from the AI.

conversation.aiOffHint: AI assistance is turned off for this conversation.

composer.outsideWindow: The customer's last message is more than 24 hours old, so the channel doesn't allow a reply now. Add a team note in the side panel, or answer when they write again.
composer.shortcuts: Ctrl+Enter to send · / for saved replies

customer.title: Customer details
customer.leadHint: Classified by the AI; your team can change it.
customer.ordersHint: Order requests need a team member's approval before they become orders.
customer.personAnswering: A team member is answering this customer.

notifications.title: Notifications
notifications.subtitle: Know when your team needs to step in. Let AI handle the routine conversations.

summary.hint: These items stay open until your team resolves them.

notifications.empty: Nothing here. You're all caught up.
notifications.openingHint: Opening a conversation does not resolve its notification.

handoff.title: {{name}} wants to speak with your team
handoff.description: The AI paused its replies after the customer asked for a person.
handoff.label: Human handoff

aiReview.title: AI needs an answer about your {{detail}}
aiReview.description: The knowledge base does not cover this question. Review before replying.
aiReview.label: AI review

orderRequest.title: New order request from {{name}}
orderRequest.description: {{detail}} · cash on delivery. Approve it before it becomes an order.
orderRequest.label: Order request

hotLead.title: {{name}} is a hot lead
hotLead.description: The AI marked this conversation as a likely buyer.
hotLead.label: Hot lead

auth.name: Your name
auth.passwordHint: At least 12 characters. A few words together are easy to remember and hard to guess.

signup.title: Create your workspace
signup.intro: One inbox for Messenger, Instagram and WhatsApp, with an AI agent that answers for you.

checkEmail.title: Check your email
checkEmail.text: We sent a confirmation link to {{email}}. It expires in one hour.
checkEmail.textNoEmail: We sent you a confirmation link. It expires in one hour.
checkEmail.resent: If this account still needs confirming, a new link is on its way.

forgot.title: Reset your password
forgot.intro: Enter the email of your account and we will send you a link.
forgot.sent: If an account exists for this email, a reset link is on its way. It expires in one hour.

reset.title: Choose a new password
reset.intro: You will be signed out everywhere and can sign in with the new password.
reset.done: Password changed. Sign in with your new password.

mfa.title: Two-step sign-in
mfa.intro: Enter the 6-digit code from your authenticator app.
mfa.recoveryIntro: Enter one of your recovery codes. Each code works once.

authErrors.emailNotVerified: Confirm your email address first. Check your inbox or ask for a new link.
authErrors.invalidToken: This link is invalid, already used or expired.
authErrors.breachedPassword: This password appears in known data breaches. Choose a different one.
authErrors.rateLimited: Too many attempts. Wait a few minutes and try again.
authErrors.generic: Something went wrong. Please try again.
authErrors.invalidMfaCode: That code isn’t right. Try the newest code from your app.
authErrors.mfaChallengeExpired: This step timed out. Sign in again.
authErrors.reauthRequired: Enter your password again to continue.

policies.title: Shop policies
policies.intro: What the AI tells customers about returns, payment and how to reach you. Leave a field empty and the AI hands those questions to your team.
policies.readOnly: Only Owners and Admins can change the shop knowledge.
policies.shippingNotesHint: e.g. courier, tracking, cut-off time. Costs and delivery times go in the zones above.
policies.returnDaysInvalid: Enter a number of days from 0 to 365.
policies.returnPolicyPlaceholder: e.g. Unused items in their original packaging. Return shipping €5.00, refund within 7 days.
policies.paymentFixed: the only payment method for now
policies.contactIntro: The AI shares these exactly as written, and nothing else.

zones.title: Shipping zones
zones.intro: Where you deliver, what it costs and how long it takes. The AI quotes only these costs.
zones.empty: No zones yet. Until you add one, the AI hands shipping-cost questions to your team.
zones.name: Zone
zones.areasPlaceholder: e.g. All of Italy except the islands
zones.invalid: Check this zone: it needs a name and a cost like 5.90; days are whole numbers and max isn’t below min.

team.intro: Invite the people who answer your customers. Owners and Admins manage the team; Members work in the inbox.

invite.title: Invite a team member
invite.sent: Invitation sent. The link is valid for 48 hours.

acceptInvite.title: Join {{workspace}}
acceptInvite.intro: {{inviter}} invited {{email}} as {{role}}. Choose your name and a password to join.

teamErrors.forbidden: Your role does not allow this.
teamErrors.alreadyMember: This person is already in the team.
teamErrors.ownerIsFixed: The Owner can’t be removed or changed.
teamErrors.invitationInvalid: This invitation is invalid, already used or expired. Ask for a new one.
teamErrors.emailHasAccount: This email already has a Nihasdesk account. Joining a second workspace comes later.

reauth.title: Confirm it’s you
reauth.intro: Enter your password to continue. You won’t be asked again for 10 minutes.

reminder.text: Protect your shop: turn on two-step sign-in so a stolen password alone can’t open your account.

mfa.title: Two-step sign-in
mfa.intro: After your password, sign-in also asks for a code from an authenticator app (Google Authenticator, Microsoft Authenticator, 1Password…).
mfa.scan: Scan the QR code with your authenticator app, then enter the 6-digit code it shows.
mfa.qrLabel: QR code for your authenticator app
mfa.codesWarning: Save these recovery codes somewhere safe. Each one signs you in once if you lose your phone. They are shown only now.

sessions.title: Signed-in devices
sessions.intro: Sign out devices you don’t recognise or no longer use.

password.title: Password
password.intro: Changing your password signs you out on all other devices.
password.changed: Password changed. Other devices were signed out.

channelSettings.intro: Connect the channels your customers write on. Their messages arrive in the inbox, and your team and the AI answer from there.
channelSettings.ownersOnly: Only Owners and Admins can connect channels.
channelSettings.disconnectHint: New messages from this Page will stop arriving. Conversations already in the inbox stay.

messenger.title: Facebook Messenger
messenger.intro: Answer messages sent to your Facebook Page.
messenger.hint: You'll sign in with Facebook and choose the Pages to connect. You need to be an admin of the Page.

result.elsewhere_one: {{count}} Page is already connected to another Nihasdesk workspace and was skipped.
result.elsewhere_other: {{count}} Pages are already connected to another Nihasdesk workspace and were skipped.
result.none: No Page was connected. Choose at least one Page you manage on Facebook.
result.cancelled: Connecting was cancelled on Facebook. Nothing changed.
result.invalid_state: That link has expired or wasn't started here. Please try connecting again.
result.meta_failed: Facebook didn't respond as expected. Please try again in a moment.

errors.notConfigured: Facebook isn't set up on this server yet. Ask the Nihasdesk team for help.
errors.notFound: This connection no longer exists. Refresh the page.

empty.title: No products yet
empty.text: Add your products by hand or import a CSV (Shopify exports work as they are). The AI answers prices and stock only from here.

products.readOnly: Only Owners and Admins can change products.
products.noOptions: No options: the product is sold in one version. Add options like Size or Colour to sell variants.

errors.title: A title is required.
errors.skuTaken: A SKU is already used by another product.
errors.handleTaken: Another product already uses this handle.

import.title: Import products
import.templateHint: Use our template, or export your products from Shopify and upload that file as it is. Excel files with semicolons work too.
import.tooLarge: The file is larger than 2 MB.
import.allOrNothing: Everything is saved at once, or nothing.

errors.notCsv: This isn’t a CSV text file. Save it as CSV (UTF-8) and try again.

aiSettings.title: AI assistant
aiSettings.intro: The AI answers customers from your catalog and the answers your team taught it. When it doesn’t know, it hands the conversation to your team.
aiSettings.notConfigured: The AI isn’t connected on this server yet (no OpenAI key). Until then your team answers everything.
aiSettings.instructionsPlaceholder: e.g. Always mention that shipping is free over €50. Don’t promise delivery dates.
aiSettings.instructionsHint: Plain language. The AI follows it, but never against its safety rules (no made-up prices, no links).
aiSettings.disclosureHint: Said once, before the AI’s first answer, so customers know they are talking to an AI (required by EU law). Leave empty for the default.
aiSettings.ownersOnly: Only Owners and Admins can change the AI.
aiSettings.knowledgeHint: What the AI knows — shipping costs, returns, payment, contact details and your FAQ — is under

questions.title: Questions the AI couldn’t answer
questions.intro: Write the answer once: the AI uses it the next time someone asks.
questions.empty: Nothing waiting. The AI knew the answers so far.
questions.resolved: This question was already answered or dismissed.

answers.intro: Your FAQ: answers you wrote, and answers taught from questions the AI couldn’t answer. Switch one off if it’s out of date.
answers.question: Question
answers.off: Switched off: the AI doesn’t use it.

aiTest.title: Test chat
aiTest.intro: Write like a customer. Nothing is saved or sent to anyone.
aiTest.placeholder: e.g. Do you have the black bag in stock?
aiTest.handoff: The AI would hand this to your team ({{reason}}).
aiTest.unknownHint: In a real chat this question would appear under “Questions the AI couldn’t answer”.
aiTest.blocked: The AI’s draft would be held back ({{reason}}) and your team asked to answer.
aiTest.limit: Too many test messages in the last hour. Please try again later.

reasons.ai_unavailable: the AI isn’t available right now

blockedReasons.price_not_from_tool: a price that isn’t from your catalog

failedReasons.http_401: OpenAI didn’t accept the API key (401) — check the key and the project region
failedReasons.http_429: OpenAI refused for now (429): no credit left or too many requests
failedReasons.output_limit: it ran out of room for the answer (output limit)

notes.placeholder: Write a note for your team. Type @ to mention someone.
notes.mentionedYou: You were mentioned in a team note.

savedReplies.title: Saved replies
savedReplies.intro: Ready-made answers your team inserts by typing / in the reply box. They are put in the reply to edit, never sent by themselves.
savedReplies.variables: You can use {first_name} (the customer’s first name) and {shop_name}. The customer’s language decides which text is used.
savedReplies.shortcutTaken: Another saved reply already uses this shortcut.

assistant.intro: A summary and a suggested reply from the AI. You edit and send it with the normal Send.
assistant.blocked: The AI couldn’t write a safe suggestion (e.g. a price that isn’t in the catalog). Try again or answer yourself.
assistant.failed: The AI isn’t available right now. Try again in a moment.

errors.off: The AI is switched off for this workspace (Settings → AI).
errors.limit: Today’s limit for AI suggestions is reached.
errors.notConfigured: The AI isn’t set up on this server yet.
errors.noMessages: There is nothing to suggest a reply to yet.

knowledge.title: Save as knowledge
knowledge.offer: You edited the AI’s suggestion. Save the answer so the AI knows it next time?
knowledge.question: Customer question
